recommendations.expected_impact: Improves public perception, increases likelihood of review updates, increases customer recovery and retention, and provides input for operational fixes.
recommendations.suggested_metric: Average first-response time <24 hours and 100% of negative reviews (≤3★) acknowledged within 24h.
